name: Subtract Array
description: This keyword is used to subtract a value from the entire series /array of the selected instrument. This keyword is used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword is used to subtract a value from the entire series /array of the selected instrument. This keyword is used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632143170.png)

The above example will subtract 10 from all the close values of the NIFTY 50 series.

Suppose Nifty yesterday's close value is 17000, it will return 17000-10= 16950
